subject: Workplace Skills
title: Running Inclusive Remote Workshops
description: A short lesson to help you apply Running Inclusive Remote Workshops.

hook.text: A brainstorm was dominated by three extroverts while seven people silently watched on mute.

buildup.text: Remote workshops amplify participation gaps. Without structure, the loud speak and the quiet vanish.

discovery.text: Use rounds and timers. Give everyone 60 seconds to share, in order. Equal airtime changes outcomes.

twist.text: Anonymous digital sticky notes collect honest opinions from people who won't challenge the boss aloud.

climax.text: Combine silent writing, anonymous posting, then structured discussion. Introverts contribute; ideas improve.

punchline.text: Structure creates equal voice. Free-form creates silence.

quiz.question: How do you ensure inclusive participation in remote workshops?
options: Ask people to unmute when they want to speak
Use structured rounds, timers, and anonymous input tools
Keep the group small so everyone naturally participates
